facts.text: San Ysidro Ranch is set in the leafy foothills of Santa Barbara.
facts.excerpt: Tucked away in the leafy foothills of Santa Barbara, San Ysidro Ranch offers a unique blend of privacy, peace, and tranquility in an idyllic setting.

facts.text: Guests stay in vine-covered cottages surrounded by landscaped gardens.
facts.excerpt: Thirty-eight vine-covered cottages surrounded by incredibly landscaped gardens with flowers always in bloom

facts.text: Individually decorated cottages have a gated entry with an enclosed garden and adjacent private parking.
facts.excerpt: Individually decorated cottages feature a gated entry with an enclosed garden and adjacent private parking.

facts.text: Cottage furnishings include Persian rugs, stone fireplaces, king-sized four-poster beds, oversized sunken spas and outdoor rainfall showers.
facts.excerpt: Furnishings include Persian rugs, stone fireplaces, king-sized four-poster beds, oversized sunken spas, and outdoor rainfall showers.

facts.text: Dining at the Ranch is included complimentary with each stay.
facts.excerpt: The Ranch offers a range of premier dining experiences, all included complimentary with each stay

facts.text: Herbs and vegetables for the restaurants come from the onsite chef's garden.
facts.excerpt: showcasing a rich palette of herbs and vegetables sourced from the onsite chef's garden

facts.text: The Stonehouse restaurant is set inside a 19th-century citrus packing house.
facts.excerpt: Set inside a 19th-century citrus packing house

facts.text: The Stonehouse has an ocean-view terrace.
facts.excerpt: Gather in the lounge and dine under the romantic lights of the ocean-view terrace

facts.text: The Stonehouse is a Wine Spectator Grand Award recipient.
facts.excerpt: A wine Spectator Grand Award recipient and Michelin-recognized, The Stonehouse is included complimentary with every stay.

facts.text: The Speakeasy, inspired by Prohibition-era bars, offers handcrafted cocktails, rare spirits and live music nightly.
facts.excerpt: Inspired by the clandestine bars of Prohibition, The Speakeasy is an intimate escape of handcrafted cocktails, rare spirits, and live music nightly.

facts.text: The Speakeasy is a Forbes Travel Guide Star Bar.
facts.excerpt: As a Forbes Travel Guide Star Bar—one of only 37 worldwide

facts.text: Afternoon Tea is served in the Veranda with house-made pastries, seasonal scones and tea sandwiches.
facts.excerpt: A cherished Ranch tradition, Afternoon Tea unfolds in the Veranda with house-made pastries, seasonal scones, and refined tea sandwiches

facts.text: The Veranda offers fireside dining.
facts.excerpt: The Veranda offers fireside dining and is renowned for its afternoon tea and special celebrations.

facts.text: Chef Matt Johnson joined San Ysidro Ranch in 2008.
facts.excerpt: Matt joined the elite team at San Ysidro Ranch in 2008.

facts.text: In 2014 Chef Matt Johnson cooked a five-course dinner at The James Beard House featuring Meyer lemons grown on the Ranch's grounds.
facts.excerpt: In 2014, Matt was given the honor of crafting a five-course dinner at The James Beard House, featuring the Meyer Lemons grown here on the grounds of the San Ysidro Ranch.

facts.text: John Huston finished writing the screenplay for The African Queen while staying at the Ranch.
facts.excerpt: John Huston, who finished writing the screenplay for The African Queen while in residence

facts.text: Laurence Olivier and Vivien Leigh exchanged midnight wedding vows on the grounds.
facts.excerpt: Laurence Olivier and Vivien Leigh exchanged midnight wedding vows on the grounds

facts.text: John and Jackie Kennedy honeymooned at the Ranch in the cottage that now bears their name.
facts.excerpt: John and Jackie Kennedy honeymooning in the cottage that now bears their name

facts.text: Past guests include Groucho Marx and Winston Churchill.
facts.excerpt: The Ranch has a historical guest list: Groucho Marx, Winston Churchill, Sinclair Lewis, and John Huston

facts.text: The Pampered Pet Program is offered in pet-friendly cottages, with pet bedding and a water bowl placed in the cottage.
facts.excerpt: Plush San Ysidro Ranch pet bedding and water bowl placed in cottage

facts.text: A pet-friendly in-room dining menu is available.
facts.excerpt: Pet-friendly in-room dining menu available

facts.text: Pets are not permitted in the restaurants, bars, salon and spa, fitness center or pool areas.
facts.excerpt: Pets are not permitted in the hotel’s restaurants, bars, salon & spa, fitness center, or pool areas

facts.text: A non-refundable pet and cleaning fee of $250 applies.
facts.excerpt: A non-refundable pet and cleaning fee of $250 will be applied to your account

facts.text: The property dates back to 1892.
facts.excerpt: the property, which dates back to 1892

facts.text: Ty Warner purchased San Ysidro Ranch in 2000.
facts.excerpt: Ty Warner spared no expense when he purchased San Ysidro Ranch in 2000.

facts.text: Cottage interiors include artfully lit in-room libraries and hand-painted wallpaper in the bathrooms.
facts.excerpt: Artfully lit in-room libraries, hand-painted wallpaper in the bathrooms that even lines the ceilings of the showers, authentic antiques, and museum-quality art

facts.text: Each cottage is named after a variety of flora, such as Lotus, Fig and Honeysuckle.
facts.excerpt: Each is named after a variety of flora (Lotus, Fig, Honeysuckle, etc)

facts.text: Cottages such as Laurel are set along San Ysidro Creek.
facts.excerpt: Rooms like the 1,550-square-foot Laurel are set along the San Ysidro Creek

facts.text: The property has a pool and its own golf-putting course.
facts.excerpt: lounge by the pool, practice your short game on the property's own golf-putting course

facts.text: The Ranch has a 14,000-bottle wine cellar with a 70-vintage vertical collection of Chateau Petrus dating back to 1945.
facts.excerpt: 14,000-bottle wine cellar with a 70-vintage vertical collection of Château Petrus dating back to 1945

facts.text: Spa therapies use oils made from the property's own lavender, rosemary and lemons.
facts.excerpt: therapies using oils made from the property's own lavender, rosemary, and lemons

facts.text: The spa has a full separate salon.
facts.excerpt: the spa is designed to accommodate bridal parties extremely well with its full separate salon

facts.text: Only registered guests or those with a restaurant reservation are likely to get through the gates.
facts.excerpt: If you're not on the list (meaning a registered hotel guest or have a reservation at the restaurant), you're likely not going to get through the gates.

facts.text: There is no kids club.
facts.excerpt: There's no kids club, no dedicated high-tech video game room

facts.text: There are electric car charging stations next to each bungalow.
facts.excerpt: there are electric car charging stations next to each of the 38 bungalows, and four at the restaurant

facts.text: The hillside property is sloped, but there are not many stairs and access ramps exist where needed.
facts.excerpt: Although the hillside property is sloped, there aren't many stairs to worry about, and access ramps exist where needed.

facts.text: The resort sits in the hills at a slight elevation, which often puts it above the coastal fog.
facts.excerpt: located in the hills at a slight elevation, which often means it's above the fog

facts.text: Staff can arrange a private wine cellar tour, hikes on adjacent trails or access to the area's golf clubs.
facts.excerpt: exploring the wine cellar on a private tour, hiking through the adjacent trails, or getting access to the area's golf clubs

facts.text: The drive up San Ysidro Road from the freeway takes six minutes.
facts.excerpt: the six-minute drive up San Ysidro Road will pass through some of the most stunning homes in all of California

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler named San Ysidro Ranch to its Gold List 2025.
facts.excerpt: Gold List 2025
